svg.title: Gulf Stream / published regional width definitions
svg.desc: Left:145,140,120 km; author mean135 km. Finite occupation span120–145 km; no annual extrema or error inferred. Authors extend transport curves to zero, including all inshore edges. Width follows a fixed135-degree baseline, not a rotated jet frame. Right:100/400 dbar pressure contours on a density surface are not fixed100–400 m depth bounds or velocity edges. Historical archive cutoffApril1990; exact local averaging dates unresolved. Meandering/smoothing context stays separate. Different locations, periods, layers and boundary operators. No pooled135–300 km range or whole-current/system width. Sources: Richardson & Knauss1971, pp1094–1095/1107; Lozier, Owens & Curry1995, p17. Independent OSW graphic.
